title: Skill Tinkering
wikitext:
Tinkering is a gnome-only trade skill. [[Gnome]]s start out with a tinkering skill of 50 and a gnome character cannot raise tinker until he reaches level 16. Tinkering can be expensive to raise, but some items such as the collapsible fishing pole, mechanized lockpicks, aqualungs and rebreathers are marketable to other players and can be used to fund a character's later tinkering endeavors. Combine ingredients in a [[Toolbox]].

== Raising Tinkering Skill ==
'''Intelligence or Wisdom, whichever is higher governs your chance to gain skill increases.'''

A good progression of items to make to raise your skill. Remember you start at 50!

# '''Flameless Lantern''' to 68
# '''Stalking Probes''' to 102
# '''Power Gloves''' to 122
# '''Aqualung''' to 148
# '''Rebreathers''' to 175

== Cultural Tinkering ==

Cultural tinkering of '''Clockwork Watchman''' (the analog of cultural smithing and tailoring, for gnomes to make a race specific armor set) was implemented during Velious.

See [[Cultural Tradeskills: Gnome]] for complete recipe list.
